spans.text: Do you know of any relevant stories, Kimie?

units.rawText: Kaede-sama told me about them before. According to legend, children going missing were the work of a yokai called the "tengu".
units.displayText: Kaede-sama told me about them before. According to legend, children going missing were the work of a yokai called the "tengu".

spans.text: Kaede-sama told me about them before. According to legend, children going missing were the work of a yokai called the "tengu".

units.rawText: Are you talking about the daitengu? You know, the yokai with big red faces and very long noses?
units.displayText: Are you talking about the daitengu? You know, the yokai with big red faces and very long noses?

spans.text: Are you talking about the daitengu? You know, the yokai with big red faces and very long noses?

units.rawText: They were slightly different from the ones of which you speak. It was another kind of tengu which kidnapped children; you might know them as "karasu-tengu".
units.displayText: They were slightly different from the ones of which you speak. It was another kind of tengu which kidnapped children; you might know them as "karasu-tengu".

units.rawText: Did they kidnap kids to eat them?

units.rawText: The records state that the children taken by the tengu would follow them in touring the land and seeing marvelous sights.

spans.text: The records state that the children taken by the tengu would follow them in touring the land and seeing marvelous sights.

units.rawText: After several months or perhaps years, the tengu would safely return the children... Zangyin-sama, where are you going?

units.rawText: Well, if they're going to give her back, then why the hell are we even looking for her?! She's getting a free trip AND inspiration out of this!

units.rawText: God, who CARES if a tengu took her? She'll just come back and turn in a script one month later! Why am I even going through all this trouble?

units.rawText: Hehe, that said, it is but a folk tale. Please consider it entertainment, but do not take it too seriously.
